CustomField.description: Holds the page section shown in slot 15, the last of the 15 numbered slots (Section 1 to Section 15) on a page; the slots also feed the Has Assigned Sections checkbox. For more sections, split the content across pages. Assign and reorder sections in the page section configurator rather than editing these lookups. If the section is deleted, the slot is cleared.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The section shown in slot 15, the last slot on a page. For more sections, split the content across pages. The page section configurator sets and reorders these slots.
CustomField.label: Form Component Section (15)
